properties.name: Green Line Phase 1
properties.timeline: Southeast segment from Shepard to Event Centre/Grand Central under construction; opening targeted for 2031. Downtown segment still in planning and design.
properties.description: Calgary's Green Line Phase 1 SE project is a 16-kilometre light rail corridor from Shepard near 130 Avenue S.E. to Event Centre/Grand Central Station on the east side of downtown, with 10 stations, two river crossings, and a new LRV maintenance facility.
milestones: Station locations not yet mapped as point features

properties.timeline: Longer-term Green Line network beyond the SE Phase 1 delivery; schedule subject to City of Calgary phasing.
properties.description: Green Line Phase 2 represents planned light rail expansion beyond the SE Phase 1 build, extending the north-south corridor using City of Calgary alignment open data. Delivery scope and timing remain subject to future approvals.
milestones: Future alignment represented from City open data

properties.name: Finch West LRT
properties.timeline: Line 6 Finch West opened to riders in 2025.
properties.description: The Finch West LRT runs between Humber College and Finch West with 18 stations and stops.

properties.name: Hazel McCallion Line
properties.timeline: 18-kilometre line from Port Credit GO to Brampton Gateway Terminal.
properties.description: The Hurontario LRT, named the Hazel McCallion Line, is being built with 19 stops along Hurontario Street.

properties.name: Hamilton B-Line LRT
properties.timeline: 14-kilometre corridor from McMaster University to Eastgate Square.
properties.description: Hamilton's B-Line LRT will run on dedicated tracks through the lower city from McMaster University to Eastgate Square.

properties.name: Ontario Line
properties.timeline: 15.6-kilometre subway line from Exhibition Place to the Don Mills and Eglinton area.
properties.description: The Ontario Line will run from Exhibition Place through downtown Toronto to the Don Mills and Eglinton area with 15 stations.

properties.name: Scarborough Subway Extension
properties.timeline: 7.8-kilometre extension from Kennedy Station to McCowan Road.
properties.description: The Scarborough Subway Extension will extend Line 2 from Kennedy to McCowan Road with three new stations.

properties.name: Yonge North Subway Extension
properties.timeline: 7.4-kilometre extension north from Finch Station to Richmond Hill Centre.
properties.description: The Yonge North Subway Extension will extend Line 1 from Finch Station to Richmond Hill Centre with six new stations.

properties.name: Eglinton Crosstown West Extension
properties.timeline: 9.2-kilometre extension from Mount Dennis to Renforth, with an airport segment advancing west to Pearson.
properties.description: The Eglinton Crosstown West Extension will continue Line 5 from Mount Dennis through Etobicoke to Pearson Airport with 11 mapped stations.

properties.name: ION Stage 2
properties.timeline: 17-kilometre extension from Fairway Station to Downtown Cambridge.
properties.description: ION Stage 2 will extend the Waterloo Region ION network from Fairway Station to Downtown Cambridge. Station locations are not presented as final here.

properties.name: Durham-Scarborough BRT
properties.timeline: Regional BRT corridor connecting Scarborough with Durham Region.
properties.description: The Durham-Scarborough BRT is a planned rapid bus corridor from Scarborough Centre east through Durham Region.

properties.name: Eglinton Crosstown LRT
properties.timeline: Line 5 Eglinton opened to riders in 2026.
properties.description: The 19-kilometre Eglinton Crosstown LRT runs between Mount Dennis and Kennedy with 25 stations and stops.
